6.NS.B.3.description: Fluently add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals using the standard algorithm for each operation.

7.RP.A.3.description: Use proportional relationships to solve multistep ratio and percent problems.

7.NS.A.3.description: Solve real-world and mathematical problems involving the four operations with rational numbers.

7.EE.B.4.a.description: Solve word problems leading to equations of the form px + q = r and p(x + q) = r.

6.RP.A.3.c.description: Find a percent of a quantity as a rate per 100; solve problems involving finding the whole given a part and the percent.

7.EE.B.4.description: Use variables to represent quantities ... construct simple equations and inequalities.

6.RP.A.3.description: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems.

descriptions.6.NS.B.2: Fluently divide multi-digit numbers using the standard algorithm.
descriptions.5.NBT.B.5: Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.
descriptions.5.NBT.B.6: Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors, using strategies based on place value, the properties of operations, and/or the relationship between multiplication and division. Illustrate and explain the calculation by using equations, rectangular arrays, and/or area models.
descriptions.5.NBT.B.7: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths, using concrete models or drawings and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction; relate the strategy to a written method and explain the reasoning used.
descriptions.7.RP.A.2: Recognize and represent proportional relationships between quantities.
descriptions.4.OA.A.3: Solve multistep word problems posed with whole numbers and having whole-number answers using the four operations, including problems in which remainders must be interpreted. Represent these problems using equations with a letter standing for the unknown quantity. Assess the reasonableness of answers using mental computation and estimation strategies including rounding.
descriptions.6.EE.B.6: Use variables to represent numbers and write expressions when solving a real-world or mathematical problem; understand that a variable can represent an unknown number, or, depending on the purpose at hand, any number in a specified set.
descriptions.6.EE.B.7: Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of the form $x + p = q$ and $px = q$ for cases in which $p$, $q$ and $x$ are all nonnegative rational numbers.
descriptions.6.RP.A.2: Understand the concept of a unit rate $\frac{a}{b}$ associated with a ratio a:b with $b \neq 0$, and use rate language in the context of a ratio relationship.
descriptions.7.NS.A.2.c: Apply properties of operations as strategies to multiply and divide rational numbers.
descriptions.7.NS.A.1.d: Apply properties of operations as strategies to add and subtract rational numbers.
descriptions.7.NS.A.2.d: Convert a rational number to a decimal using long division; know that the decimal form of a rational number terminates in 0s or eventually repeats.
